text:
alex: Heads-up — vendor sync tomorrow 10:30am PT to lock down announcement/embargo windows for H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi. Need clarity on press slot availability and SI readiness. Can everyone who owns a lane confirm?

maria: I can cover marketplace listing cadence and compliance checks. Need final SKU list by EOD today.

raj: Platform check — driver/firmware milestone is the gating item for Dedicated and Private images. Partner asks for a firm date for GA drivers. Do we have one?

simon: Not yet. Nvidia said firmware sign-off target is ~Mar 31 but could slip. Gaudi/MI300 vendors gave tentative mid-Apr windows.

ellie: Marketing needs a 2-week embargo lead for any co-announcement content. Also need partner co-branding assets by next Tue.

alex: Ok. Proposal: staggered public windows per vendor to avoid cross-press collisions. Example plan: small table ->

alex: ```
- Week 1: Early access (partners + SI previews) -> H100 (canary), Gaudi (preview)
- Week 2: Marketplace listing + docs -> MI300, B200
- Week 3: Public announcement (press + blog) -> H200 + aggregated partner quotes
```

maria: That looks reasonable. Marketplace team can push listings as they are signed off, but listings need validated images. We should tie listing publish to `driver_signoff` tag.

raj: Agreed. I'll create a `driver_signoff` flag in the checklist. Can someone confirm who owns vendor liaison for MI300? @partner-bot do we have a vendor contact list?

partner-bot: Vendor contact sheet: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/partners/pages/MI300+-+Partners (shared) :link:

alex: Thanks. Assigning owners: Raj -> driver coordination + canary images; Maria -> marketplace listing + SKU mapping; Simon -> integration smoke tests and SI readiness; Ellie -> comms/embargo sync.

ellie: I'll draft the embargo language and partner opt-in notes. Will share a doc by EOD.

maria: Quick question — do we allow marketplace pre-list (hidden) before public? That would help SI onboarding.

alex: Yes, hidden pre-listing for SI is fine but must be gated by `canary_image_ok` and `driver_signoff`. No public copy before Ellis's embargo window.

raj: Timeline ask: can CI run nightly smoke tests on canary images? If yes, SI teams can get a rolling image. We need to coordinate lab slots for Gaudi (limited capacity).

simon: Labs: Gaudi slots available Apr 6-12 (limited). I'll reserve 3 slots for SI dry-run.

ellie: Marketing note: press embargo lifts should avoid Thursdays (industry busy). Prefer Tue/Wed.

alex: Action items recap:
- Raj: create driver_signoff checklist + enable nightly CI for canaries (owner)
- Maria: SKU list + marketplace pre-list workflow (owner)
- Simon: Reserve Gaudi lab slots and SI dry-run plan (owner)
- Ellie: Draft embargo copy + partner opt-in doc (owner)

alex: Also: need a fallback model mapping if H200 slips — plan to route traffic to H100/B200 variants in Dedicated for first 2 weeks. Ops/Runtime needs to prepare automatic routing rules.

raj: I'll add a routing policy entry: `fallback: H200 -> H100|B200` and test in staging.

maria: Can we also flag pricing/quotas for dedicated capacity in the marketplace listing? Should be in the SKU metadata.

ellie: I'll loop in enterprise sales for pricing quotes.

alex: Partner comms: we should run a 30-min dry run with vendor PMs and SI leads next Wed 11am PT. Who's available?

maria: I'm in.

raj: I can make it.

simon: Available.

ellie: Yep.

partner-bot: Calendar invite created: "HW Launch dry run — vendor + SI" Wed 11:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1713102468-dryrun

alex: Perfect. One more ask: any one-off embargo/legal requirements from vendors? Nvidia asked for a 48-hour embargo review on quotes. Add to checklist.

maria: Noted. Adding `vendor_quote_review_48h` to the runbook.

raj: I'll open a tracking ticket and link to the driver artifacts once CI starts producing canary builds.

simon: Will prepare a short smoke test matrix and post in the dry run doc. Example checks: basic inference, batching, model hotstart, KV cache integrity.

ellie: Thank you all — I'll post the embargo doc and a partner-facing checklist in the calendar event.

alex: Thanks team. If there are new slips from vendor side, bump this thread and we can re-sync quickly. :thumbsup:
